about_the_game:
Synopsis

The hustle and bustle of the world, passing for a hundred years, with all thoughts lost, why not focus on cultivating truth and wandering freely in the world?

Fantasy cultivation takes you into the world of cultivation, where treasures and divine powers, spiritual roots and techniques, Dao heart and Dao fruit are used to interpret infinite power

Boundary division

Ordinary fetus, innate, cultivating qi, building foundation, golden pill, elemental baby, elemental god, combination, enlightenment, true immortal, earth immortal, heavenly immortal, Da Luo golden immortal, mixed elemental golden immortal, infinite golden immortal, Dao Zu sage, many realms, all in the realm of fantasy cultivation

Gameplay

Step 1: Registration and login in the selected area (unable to register in a fully populated area), verification with a picture verification code and email, and login with a picture verification code;

Step 2: Enter the track number, create a character, and descend to enter the game interface;

Part Three: Obtain Dao Xing (in the endless practice, obtain Dao Xing every second), break through the realm (mortal, innate, cultivate qi, build foundation, golden pill, elemental infant, elemental spirit, merge, comprehend Dao, true immortal, earth immortal, heavenly immortal, Da Luo Golden Immortal, mixed element Golden Immortal, infinite Golden Immortal, Taoist ancestor saint);

Step 4: Demon Trial Challenge, obtain Spirit Stones, and receive additional rewards in certain levels;

Step 5: Treasure Hunt in the Treasure Pavilion to obtain treasures, divine powers, spiritual roots, martial arts, Dao Heart, Dao Fruit, Dao Xing Card... Items can be viewed in the Na Jie; Baoge points can be exchanged for items, and the exclamation mark on the right side of the green points can be clicked to open the exchange interface;

Step 6: The immortal realm spirit stone veins can be collected to obtain spirit stones;

Step 7: Cultivation - Cultivation Configuration, which can equip magic weapons, divine powers, spiritual roots, techniques, Dao hearts, Dao fruits, Dao cards. Clicking on the equipped props can consume Dao enhancement; The magic weapon can be decomposed in the receiving ring to obtain fragments, which can be recycled to improve the basic combat power; Dao Xing Card can be used in props; The rest can be sold to obtain spirit stones; The Heavenly Dao Stele allows you to view the ranking of realms and trials, and click on the Dao number to view detailed information; The envelope in the upper left corner can be clicked to view logs, records, gift packages, emails, and announcements.

Official player QQ communication group: 884705181, welcome fellow Taoists to come!!!
